# Flux Capacitor

![Flux Capacitor](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/capacitor.png)

Heads: 2 points per energy you hold. Tails: +1 energy.

- **Rarity:** Uncommon
- **Heads chance:** 35%
- **Shop price:** 15 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 1

## Heads
Nothing

## Tails
Gain 1 energy

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Trader](characters-trader)
